visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a black button-down shirt stands in the center of the frame. He is outdoors at night with snowflakes falling around him. He gestures with his hands and holds a blue pen. The background features several evergreen trees dusted with snow and a multi-story building with warm interior lights. (2) Close-up shots of electronic circuit boards with small gold-colored chips are shown. A hand holding a pen points to various small metal components on the green substrate. (3) The man returns to the screen, speaking with an expressive face and wide hand gestures. He continues to stand in the snowy night environment with trees behind him. (4) An animation overlay appears showing a simplified 3D model of a protein molecule (EYFP) and a diagram of a blue laser beam targeting a biological cell containing green markers. (5) Technical physics diagrams with energy level labels like S0, S1, T1, T2 and specific laser wavelengths like 488 nm and 912 nm are displayed over the man's shoulder. (6) A line graph showing Rabi oscillations with a decaying sine wave curve appears, with axes labeled in pulse length and signal ratio. (7) The man concludes his talk in the snowy setting, waving to the camera and performing a playful claw gesture with his hands at the very end.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 加入泛科學會員 一起撐開腦洞. [Slogan]: 身體裡的量子位元？ 真沒看過. (2) [Subtitle]: 科學家在細胞裡做出了 量子位元. (3) [Subtitle]: 我知道 我也納悶 量子位元超玻璃的 丟到細胞那種又濕又熱的夜市環境 不是瞬間崩潰嗎. [Variety]: 崩潰. (4) [Subtitle]: 但現在芝加哥大學的科學家 成功把一顆 EYFP 是「增強型黃色螢光蛋白」 變成活體量子位元了 成果剛登上《自然》期刊. (5) [Subtitle]: 過去的量子位元 像是鑽石、矽 都是些硬梆梆的石頭 你要把它塞進你水嫩嫩的細胞裡 就像叫巨石強森去跳 I'm your pookie in the morning. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以科學家就想 與其把石頭硬塞進去 不如叫細胞自己蓋一個量子元件出來 這就是這篇研究最猛的地方. (7) [Subtitle]: 他們選中的建材 是生物課本一定會看到的「螢光蛋白」 天生自帶「金鐘罩」 讓它能在人類冷凍細胞裡 甚至室溫的活大腸桿菌裡運作. (8) [Subtitle]: 注意了 科學家用 488 奈米雷射去照射它 讓整個分子進入帶有奈米級磁性的「三重態」 而這個「三重態」就是我們的量子位元. (9) [Subtitle]: 未來或許能用它來監控 癌細胞的早期病變 但這都還在實驗室階段 但已經打開了「生物量子科技」的大門.
